model_system: (110)-oriented antiperovskite noncollinear antiferromagnet Mn3SnN thin films and Mn3SnN(16 nm)/Py(12 nm) bilayers on MgO(110)

key_params.spin_texture: Γ4g noncollinear AFM / cluster magnetic octupole
key_params.symmetry_rule_for_sigma_z: appears for J // T and vanishes for J ⟂ T

headline_claim: Field-free deterministic switching of an adjacent perpendicular ferromagnet is realized using out-of-plane spin polarization σz generated in Mn3SnN; σz appears when current is parallel to the cluster magnetic octupole moment T and vanishes when perpendicular.
replication_difficulty: medium - primarily an experimental thin-film growth and ST-FMR/SOT-device replication with orientation-sensitive noncollinear AFM order, but no complex simulation workflow is stated.
